title: Company
description: Top-level tenant/organization operating the warehouse. Lists one or more categories and, for a multi-owner warehouse, the stock owners.

owners.description: Stock owners whose goods this company stores, e.g. the customers of a 3PL. Omit for a single-owner warehouse: items then carry no owner. Once declared, every item of this company must resolve to exactly one owner (own field or category default_attributes.owner).
